card.name: Link word between a small amount and a larger quantity
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, to, per, in, diluted) that come right after a stated quantity and just before a much larger number or amount. Seen in ratios, dilutions and crowding figures.

modes.label: Dilution or mixing
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'diluted' after a small amount of a substance, before the volume it is added to.
modes.example: 1 teaspoon of non-scented liquid household chlorine bleach<< to>> a quart of water

modes.label: Ratio or rate
modes.description: The word 'per' or 'for' after a quantity, before a larger count or area.
modes.example: 1 ft2 of attic ventilation, or net free vent area,<< per>> 300 ft2 of attic

modes.label: Crowding counts
modes.description: The word 'for' or 'in' after a count of people, before a capacity or other count.
modes.example: 26 guards and 1 instructor<< for>> about 440 prisoners

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict large-quantity words such as thousands, hundreds and millions.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a small amount where a much bigger number is about to be given.
